rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it likely overstates confidence in identifying a good ICM/TE and calls it early/expanded despite the image being suboptimal and not clearly showing all features precisely.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, prior IVF outcomes, semen parameters, diagnosis, and endometrial thickness with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with appropriate caveats about morphology and ploidy; only minor overinterpretation of image quality and probability precision.

Recommendations are largely evidence-based and aligned with standard IVF practice, including SET and cautious use of PGT-A/add-ons, though some suggestions (e.g., freeze-all/FET emphasis, chronic endometritis workup) are somewhat more individualized than guideline-mandated.

Provides clear, practical next steps for current transfer management and future planning, including monitoring after ectopic history, uterine/tubal evaluation, lining optimization, and lifestyle modification.
